1. (Currently Amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 0 (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound is a sodium enolate of a β-keto methyl ester__.

2. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is C1 -C12-alkyl, C6 -aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is methyl__.

3. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is methyl [[or ethyl]].

4. (Currently Amended) A compound of formula (Ilb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein the compound is a sodium enolate of a β-keto methyl ester__.

5. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim [[1]] __4__ of formula (Il b) in which Z is sodium [[or potassium]].
